The observed short-horizon growth and sustained long-horizon reversal support the recalled adaptation mechanism rather than a single harmonic cycle.
The existing observations span short, intermediate, and target horizons and permit fitting the four-parameter adaptation law; fresh confirmation is the appropriate next test.
